subject: Post-demo: hosted pilot configuration proposal + security clarifications
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Liu <evan@finlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Post-demo: hosted pilot configuration proposal + security clarifications

Thanks again for the demo today — appreciate the time and the specific examples you showed of the document summarization flow. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align with your security and ops teams:

- Goal: Proof-of-concept hosted pilot to validate latency, cost, and extraction quality across the 3 main production flows you showed (ocr -> summarizer, Q&A, and reranking).
- Scope we propose for the quickstart pilot: 2 sandbox endpoints (summarize-text, rerank-store), 30k total API tokens/day cap for the pilot, and a 2-week window for initial metrics.

Important ops/infra notes for your security team: we attached a preliminary SLA draft and a simple network topology diagram (SLA-draft.pdf, network-topology.png). High-level hosted capabilities relevant to your ask:
- Region selection (us-east-us or eu-west) and encryption at rest + in transit.
- Dedicated tenancy option for hosted customers (reserved capacity pool) for stronger isolation — not the same as VPC/private deployment.
- Prefix/KV caching and token-bounded batching to control per-request latency.

Open questions we need from you to finalize the config:
1) Expected peak QPS and average request token length (input + output).
2) Any regulatory constraints (e.g., HIPAA, PCI) or required attestations beyond SOC2 Type II.
3) Is egress residency required (data must remain in a single country)?
4) Are you okay starting on hosted sandbox endpoints while your security team reviews the attachments, or do you need a Private/VPC evaluation immediately?

Suggested immediate next steps:
- If you want to try hosted sandbox: we can provision sandbox endpoints within 48 hours and set initial rate caps (proposed: 20 requests/minute per endpoint, burst to 50 for testing).
- If security wants Private/VPC: we can coordinate an architecture review, but provisioning lead time is ~3–4 weeks.

I put Ben on cc to own the pilot provisioning and Marissa for contract/SLA coordination. If you can share answers to the 4 open questions above, we’ll send a concrete pilot config and HubSpot playbook link.

Attachments: SLA-draft.pdf (PDF, 2 pages) | network-topology.png (PNG)

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0123
From: Evan Liu <evan@finlytics.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@finlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 18:47:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo: hosted pilot configuration proposal + security clarifications

Thanks, Ava — great summary. A few answers up-front to help you configure the pilot:
- Peak: ~12 QPS sustained for summarizer during business hours, occasional spikes to ~30 QPS for short bursts.
- Typical payload: OCR'd page ~2–3k input tokens, expected summary ~200–400 tokens.
- Regulatory: We are not HIPAA bound, but our legal team asks for SOC2 evidence and a data processing addendum.
- Residency: We prefer US-only residency for the pilot.

Two extra asks from our security lead: can the hosted sandbox traffic be routed through a static egress IP (so we can allowlist)? And, if hosted is not acceptable, what is the delta in cost and lead time for Dedicated vs Private VPC?

Procurement timeline: hoping to decide on pilot approach by end of this month; procurement needs an SLA and a rough cost estimate for a 2-week pilot + 3-month follow-up.

-Evan
Evan Liu
Head of Data Products, Finlytics
evan@finlytics.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Liu <evan@finlytics.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo: hosted pilot configuration proposal + security clarifications

Hi Evan — appreciate the fast responses. Quick replies to your asks and a concrete pilot proposal below.

1) Static egress IP: For hosted sandbox we can provide a small set of static egress IPs from our cloud provider that customers can allowlist. If you require customer-owned IP egress (i.e., traffic exits through your VPC), that’s only available with Private/VPC/on-prem.

2) Dedicated vs Private delta: Dedicated (reserved capacity) gives you a dedicated GPU pool and stronger tenancy isolation with predictable throughput. Lead time: 1–2 weeks to reserve capacity + provisioning. Private VPC/on-prem: ~3–6 weeks depending on network approvals and on-prem packaging. Cost: Dedicated has a monthly reserved price (higher than hosted metered), Private includes licensing/support and infra costs — we’ll include ballpark estimates in the HubSpot deal record (HS-3421).

Pilot proposal (hosted sandbox, US region):
- Endpoints: /v1/summarize (sandbox-finlytics.redwood.com) and /v1/rerank (sandbox-finlytics.redwood.com)
- Initial caps: 30 requests/minute per endpoint, 3 concurrent connections, 50k tokens/day total across the pilot. Burst policy: allow short bursts to 60 requests/minute for 10s windows.
- Monitoring: We’ll enable token-level cost and latency dashboards for the endpoints plus a simple eval set to track quality regressions.
- Security: Provide SOC2 Type II report extract + DPA template (attached SLA-draft.pdf). We’ll also share the static egress IPs when we provision the sandbox.

Next actions:
- If that matches your ask, Ava will provision sandbox credentials and shared drive with the quickstart guide within 48 hours.
- We’ll send the HubSpot quote with pilot pricing and an optional line-item for Dedicated reservation if you want to compare.

Marissa will follow up on the SLA wording and DPA. If you prefer a migration-to-Private conversation, we can schedule a technical review with infra next week.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Evan Liu <evan@finlytics.com>

Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo: hosted pilot configuration proposal + security clarifications

Thanks team — that plan looks reasonable. Two quick items:
1) Please go ahead and provision the sandbox endpoints and share static egress IPs so our NetOps can allowlist.
2) Send the SOC2 evidence and the DPA; procurement expects those before PO.

We’re good to start the 2-week pilot once the sandbox is live. Priya (cc) will coordinate on timing.

Evan
